title: Mammals
info: Mammals have hair or fur, and mothers make milk for their babies.
People, cows, tigers, and bats are mammals. A dolphin is a mammal too, even though it lives in water.
A fish has scales and gills and is not a mammal. A bird has feathers and is not a mammal.
